metadata.title: Hypsometric-tint elevation polygons, Homestead Valley Service Area (CSA 14)
metadata.aoi_source: storymap-prototype/data/homestead.geojson (HOMESTEAD VALLEY SERVICE AREA, CSA 14, 469.24 ac)
metadata.source_dem: USGS 3DEP 1 m bare-earth DEM, project CA_NoCal_Wildfires_B5b_QL1_2018 (QL1 lidar, 2018 acquisition, published 2020-01-14), NAVD88, via USGS The National Map / AWS s3://prd-tnm. See topo_work/PROCESS.md for full provenance and QA (40/40 checks pass).
metadata.symbology: Vectorized version of the same 'hyps' hypsometric-tint colour ramp used to render storymap-prototype's homestead_topo_map.png reference graphic (topo_work/09_render_map.py). 8 classes, one per ramp control-point colour, with elevation breaks at the midpoints between consecutive control-point fractions of the AOI's relief range.
metadata.vectorization_method: GDAL polygonize algorithm (rasterio.features.shapes, which wraps GDALPolygonize), 4-connectivity, exact-clipped to the CSA 14 boundary, coordinates snapped to a shared 1e-8 deg grid (shapely.set_precision) so shared pixel edges stay topologically coincident across neighbouring polygons.
